g.title: Unified measured local view
g.desc: Unified measured local view; unified window → local anchor; 20 s crop · 10 boundary patches; scope inference; implementation implemented

g.title: Measured EEG input
g.desc: Measured EEG input; [B, 6, 4000]; artifact is QC annotation only; scope inference; implementation implemented

g.title: Measured fNIRS input
g.desc: Measured fNIRS input; [B, 2, 200]; paired HbO / HbR anchor; scope inference; implementation implemented

g.title: Full-trajectory rJ sidecar
g.desc: Full-trajectory rJ sidecar; 10 × 20 + point-valid mask; R1-D crossfit · R1-P population-frozen; scope training_only; implementation planned; evidence guarded; Replace sparse mean/slope sidecars with a versioned full-trajectory joint-driver sidecar.

g.title: Trajectory target adapter
g.desc: Trajectory target adapter; split full rJ into 10 positions; valid ∩ teacher ∩ support; scope training_only; implementation planned; evidence guarded; Reduce the multi-entry router to a trajectory slicer and explicit loss-mask intersection.

g.title: EEG branch rJ target
g.desc: EEG branch rJ target; full 2 s trajectory; same coordinate · independent ID; scope training_only; implementation planned; evidence guarded; Both modalities receive the same full joint-driver coordinate without same-ID supervision.

g.title: fNIRS branch rJ target
g.desc: fNIRS branch rJ target; full 2 s trajectory; same coordinate · independent ID; scope training_only; implementation planned; evidence guarded; Replace modality-specific HbO/HbR state summaries with the common full joint-driver target.

g.title: Validity + loss masks
g.desc: Validity + loss masks; patch boundary → encoders / VQ; point loss = boundary ∩ teacher ∩ target; scope inference; implementation planned; evidence guarded; Use one explicit support intersection in training, validation, and frozen probes.

g.title: EEG raw patch stem
g.desc: EEG raw patch stem; 10 × 2 s measured patches; no teacher / task / nuisance input; scope inference; implementation planned; Keep raw EEG patch embeddings but remove patch-local token identity.

g.title: EEG patch features
g.desc: EEG patch features; modality-only features; feeds full-window context; scope inference; implementation planned; Use the existing encoder position as a modality-specific patch feature stem.

g.title: EEG semantic latent
g.desc: EEG semantic latent; 10 × D64; driver-oriented coordinate; scope inference; implementation planned; evidence guarded; Semantic latent is now produced from the full-window modality-only encoder.

g.title: EEG EMA VQ
g.desc: EEG EMA VQ; K=128 · D=64 · count/sum; invalid tokens excluded; scope inference; implementation implemented

g.title: EEG residual
g.desc: EEG residual; continuous latent 64; information preservation; scope inference; implementation removed; Remove the mandatory residual branch from the minimal core; a continuous private path is an R4 ablation only.

g.title: EEG full-window encoder
g.desc: EEG full-window encoder; 20 s offline context; 10 neural-time outputs; scope inference; implementation planned; Move temporal context before semantic projection and quantization to match the full-window teacher.

g.title: fNIRS raw patch stem
g.desc: fNIRS raw patch stem; 10 × 2 s HbO/HbR patches; no teacher / task / nuisance input; scope inference; implementation planned; Keep raw paired HbO/HbR patch embeddings without nuisance or teacher inputs.

g.title: fNIRS patch features
g.desc: fNIRS patch features; modality-only features; feeds full-window context; scope inference; implementation planned; Use the existing encoder position as a modality-specific patch feature stem.

g.title: fNIRS semantic latent
g.desc: fNIRS semantic latent; 10 × D64; driver-oriented coordinate; scope inference; implementation planned; evidence guarded; Semantic latent is now produced from the full-window modality-only encoder.

g.title: fNIRS EMA VQ
g.desc: fNIRS EMA VQ; K=128 · D=64 · count/sum; invalid tokens excluded; scope inference; implementation implemented

g.title: fNIRS residual
g.desc: fNIRS residual; continuous latent 32; information preservation; scope inference; implementation removed; Remove the mandatory residual branch from the minimal core; a continuous private path is an R4 ablation only.

g.title: fNIRS full-window encoder
g.desc: fNIRS full-window encoder; 20 s offline context; 10 neural-time outputs; scope inference; implementation planned; Move temporal context before quantization so fNIRS can use delayed full-window evidence.

g.title: Shared driver decoder Dr
g.desc: Shared driver decoder Dr; D64 → 20 trajectory samples; no modality ID · no same-ID loss; scope training_only; implementation planned; evidence guarded; Replace routed multi-head objectives with one shared decoder used by both independent codebooks.

text.tspan: no modality ID · no same-ID loss

g.title: Primary trajectory objective
g.desc: Primary trajectory objective; full rJ SmoothL1 + VQ; no raw / pair / coupling loss; scope training_only; implementation planned; evidence guarded; Make full joint-driver trajectory reconstruction the primary semantic objective and remove raw reconstruction from the core.

g.title: R2-P → R3-P promotion gate
g.desc: R2-P → R3-P promotion gate; R1-P panel + continuous first; then K128 semantic conjunction; scope governance; implementation planned; evidence guarded; Require dual-modality continuous observability before allowing the K128 semantic run.

g.title: Frozen checkpoint
g.desc: Frozen checkpoint; codebooks + model state; hash + run manifest; scope export; implementation implemented

g.title: P5 export v1
g.desc: P5 export v1; IDs · posterior · expected; residual · targets · provenance; scope export; implementation implemented

g.title: R6A development evaluator
g.desc: R6A development evaluator; bidirectional-token offline association; fit 01–18 · apply 19–23 + nulls; scope evaluation; implementation planned; evidence blocked; Replace the required foundation stage with a development frozen q0/q1 evaluator for offline association.

g.title: R6B prospective cutoff
g.desc: R6B prospective cutoff; absolute RF end + embargo < endpoint; future raw fNIRS + matched nulls; scope evaluation; implementation planned; evidence blocked; Future prediction is a separate strict-cutoff mode; it is invalid when token receptive fields overlap the endpoint.
